authority: Owner-authorized read-only discovery pilot for pre-Phase-2 published direct consumers.

scope.selection: All 22 rows whose initial_class is null.

inventory_context.note: All 16 signalled contracts in this pilot are preexisting_published_context. They were published at the baseline and are not claimed as new Phase-2 suppliers.

method: Read each consumer's complete current item.
Read every signalled contract and check its historical baseline status and current contract hash.
Check relevant declared dependencies and local arguments, including un-signalled local suppliers where needed.
Record a candidate only for an identifiable direct mathematical use lacking adequate current justification; missing metadata alone is not a candidate.
